_comment: DemoGame full world seed — owned by the game, replayed via UNpcWorldSeeder. Idempotent (engine uses MERGE semantics). Seed order enforced by UNpcWorldSeeder: locations → factions → characters → events → [edges] → quests. Inner-life (beliefs, secrets) for Aldric is deferred to Phase 5 admin endpoints (DEC-018). Tavern name: The Broken Flagon (DEC-017). Town: Thornfield. All timestamps use seed epoch 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z (DEC-020). Registry-required fields added per live engine registry (DEC-020, DEC-021). STRICTNESS: Location/Faction/Character/Event accept additionalProperties; Quest is strict — only registry fields allowed (DEC-021). Quest progression metadata (chain, chain_position, objectives, next_quest_id) lives in game-owned DataAssets, not the engine graph. Edge types are strict — no unknown fields (DEC-020).

properties.name: The Broken Flagon
properties.descriptor: The main tavern floor of The Broken Flagon in Thornfield — worn oak tables, a hearth that never quite warms the room, and Mira behind the bar.

properties.name: Back Room
properties.descriptor: A dim storeroom behind the bar in The Broken Flagon. Lira operates here. Access requires Mira's trust.

properties.name: Market Square
properties.descriptor: The open cobblestone courtyard at the centre of Thornfield. Merchant stalls, a notice board, and the constant murmur of commerce.

properties.name: Guard Barracks
properties.descriptor: The stone courtyard outside the Thornfield guard barracks. Captain Sorn's territory.

properties.name: City Guard
properties.description: Thornfield's standing guard, answerable to the crown. Captain Sorn commands the local garrison.

properties.name: Thieves Guild
properties.description: A shadow organisation that lives in the cracks of Thornfield. Lira is a local contact.

properties.name: Traveler
properties.biography: A wandering adventurer seeking fortune in Thornfield.

properties.name: Mira
properties.biography: Runs The Broken Flagon in Thornfield with an even hand and a sharp ear. Warm but guarded; never says more than she needs to.
properties.voice_descriptor: Warm, observant. Cautious about politics — frames hard news as rumour or second-hand. Shares under trust.

properties.name: Lira
properties.biography: Moves stolen goods from The Broken Flagon's back room with a smile and a story, always one step ahead of the guard.
properties.voice_descriptor: Light, deflective. Turns every question into a joke or a counter-question. Sees the northern war as leverage.

properties.name: Aldric
properties.biography: Formerly traded textiles in Riverwheel before settling in Thornfield as a wine merchant. Cautious, honest when pressed, and currently spooked by guardsmen asking questions at his stall.
properties.voice_descriptor: Measured and polite. Becomes evasive when the amulet or the northern road comes up. Rewards trust with candour.

properties.name: Captain Sorn
properties.biography: Commands the Thornfield garrison. Direct, stoic, and correct in his facts. Knows the real situation at the northern pass and will not share it lightly.
properties.voice_descriptor: Blunt and measured. Economy of words. Hard trust arc — requires honesty and persistence.

properties.name: Old Henryk
properties.biography: A fixture of Thornfield's market square. Has been here longer than anyone remembers and has heard everything — most of it wrong.
properties.voice_descriptor: Garrulous, enthusiastic, unreliable. Repeats everything he hears and embellishes freely. The end of every rumour chain.

properties.summary: A skirmish at the northern pass has been suppressed from official reports. Border soldiers are deserting.
properties.name: Northern War Begins
properties.description: A skirmish at the northern pass has been suppressed from official reports. Border soldiers are deserting.
properties.source_text: Border soldiers are deserting their posts. A skirmish at the northern pass has been suppressed from official reports.
properties.hop_1_text: There's fighting up north. Someone said half the garrison moved out last week.
properties.hop_2_text: I heard the whole northern army's fled to the hills. War's already started, they say.

properties.description: Identify the wine merchant from Riverwheel through social investigation. At least two NPCs must independently point to him.
properties.success_condition: Two NPCs independently confirm the wine merchant from Riverwheel

properties.description: Deliver the amulet to Aldric the wine merchant — or sell it to Lira for the guild.
properties.success_condition: Deliver the amulet to Aldric or sell it to Lira

properties.description: Aldric reveals the amulet's connection to the northern war and the desertion he unwittingly enabled.
properties.success_condition: Hear Aldric's confession about the amulet and the northern war

properties.description: Escort a patrol route and report back to Captain Sorn. Unlocked when Sorn's trust exceeds the threshold.
properties.success_condition: Complete the escort patrol route and return to Captain Sorn

properties.description: Captain Sorn shares the unfiltered news from the northern pass as a reward for completing the patrol.
properties.success_condition: Receive Captain Sorn's unfiltered account of the northern skirmish

properties.description: Locate a diverted guild shipment. Unlocked by Lira after the amulet sell.
properties.success_condition: Locate the diverted guild shipment and identify the culprit

properties.description: Confront the person responsible for diverting the guild shipment.
properties.success_condition: Confront the person responsible for the missing goods
